messages:
liz-chen: Heads-up — Polaris invoice shows a negative adj on Feb after the embed replay. Seeing a -$4,312 credit applied to their account. Sending quick findings.

sarah-g: Which replay/run is this tied to?

liz-chen: replay job id replay-2026-02-17-3345. Our reconciliation shows embed row delta = -23,114 (we decreased counted embeds, which triggered credit logic). Suspect dedupe logic treated replays as corrections.

ops_jun: We rolled SDK dedupe changes in Jan; could be client_generated_id handling. Can you paste the SQL you used to calc the delta?

liz-chen: Query we ran:
```
SELECT replay_id, action, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM embed_ledger
WHERE replay_id = 'replay-2026-02-17-3345'
GROUP BY replay_id, action;
```
Results: action=increment: 412,134 -> action=decrement: 435,248 => net -23,114.

reconcile-bot: Automated alert: rate-limit/retry credit rule "suppress_retries" applied for customer=polaris during 2026-02-16..2026-02-18. Credits issued: 23,114 embed units; monetary credit: $4,312. See /billing/credits/9876

sarah-g: If this was a mis-credit we should either reverse the credit + re-invoice or apply a manual adjustment. @mike-true any finance policy preference?

mike-true: Need ledger evidence and legal ok. If platform miscounted, void the credit and re-invoice. Avoid surprise manual charges to customer without CS signoff. I approve reversal up to $5k pending legal.

liz-chen: I'll open a reversal ticket and draft the customer note. Tentatively proposing to reissue invoice and offer a one-time goodwill credit of 10% of the disputed amount as conciliatory gesture.

billing-bot: Ticket created #BILL-4521 by liz-chen. Assigned to billing-team.

sarah-g: GL code for reversal? Ops suggests GL 6302 (customer credits) and offset to 4101 (usage revenue) for bookkeeping.

mike-true: Approved. @billing-team proceed with reversal and re-invoice flow. Please attach reconciliation CSV and link to replay job. CC CS for customer comms.

liz-chen: Draft email to CS (paste below) — feel free to edit:
```
Hi Polaris team,

We ran a post-replay reconciliation and found an internal count adjustment that created an incorrect credit on your Feb invoice. We're reversing the credit and will reissue an updated invoice within 3 business days. As a courtesy we're applying a 10% one-time credit on the disputed amount. Apologies for the confusion — happy to walk through the reconciliation.

Regards,
Liz (Billing)
```

ops_jun: We'll patch the dedupe pipeline to avoid decrementing counts on replays (change: treat replayed requests as idempotent increments unless explicit correction flag). ETA: next-week deploy and a follow-up job to re-validate counts.

sarah-g: Thanks all. I'll mark the finance ticket P1 and route to legal for sign-off. Close the thread once ticket is resolved. :thumbsup:
